description: Compact delivery totals for this receipt, limited to subscriptions the reader can currently inspect. May remain available when per-job details exceed the response bound or are pruned only if retained authorization evidence proves the included monitor set. Never copy unfiltered tenant-wide dedup counters. Omit deliveryCounts when ownership or current authorization cannot be resolved; omission does not mean zero. Acknowledged counts host HTTP acceptance and never proves a ChatGPT response or task execution.

matched.description: Matching delivery jobs in the authorized monitor set.

acknowledged.description: Jobs accepted through host HTTP acknowledgement; not proof of task execution.

pending.description: Nonterminal jobs, including pending and sending.

failed.description: Terminal unacknowledged jobs, including dead, dropped and cancelled.
